evidence: Single migration 0121_patient_access_pin_day_read_write.sql, unsigned until the owner signs (reviewed_by is empty). WHAT IT DOES: (a) access_requests_pin_scope_ck and consent_grants_pin_scope_ck (0033) allow scope read_records or write_records for a row whose authorization_method is patient_access_pin (still purpose direct-care and break_glass false); each dropped and added NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT. (b) CREATE OR REPLACE of identity.access_patient_with_pin(text,text,integer) from 0098's body (md5 830c1baa4bca3df57cc02b7b002a8831 before, 6453e3e4c3906e4e565fa93c2979a865 after): duration 5-1440 minutes (was 5-60); the request and grant it inserts are write_records (was read_records); a still-valid PIN grant is reused only if write_records (an older read_records PIN grant is not reused and is left to run out); a deny directive stops it if its actions are empty or include read_records or write_records (was read_records only); the success and replay audit details and the PatientAccessPinVerified payload carry scope. Every other line is 0098's; signature, result, owner, plpgsql, VOLATILE, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path identity, auth, audit, platform, pg_temp and ACL (hid_identity_runtime and hid_schema_test_runtime EXECUTE) are unchanged and compared attribute by attribute after. (c) identity_outbox_minimum_necessary (0033) accepts a PatientAccessPinVerified payload of {consentGrantId, reviewRequired} or {consentGrantId, reviewRequired, scope} with scope read_records or write_records (EmergencyAccessActivated unchanged); dropped and added NOT VALID, then validated. (d) ALTER POLICY identity_outbox_patient_access_pin_insert (0033): the grant may be read_records or write_records and the payload's scope, when present, must be the grant's; name, command, permissive and roles unchanged. No table, column, index, trigger, role, permission or grant change; runtime-grants.sql unchanged; no row written. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: identity-api reads the same result columns; today's image sends 15 or the caller's 5-60 and keeps working (the grant is then write_records for that time); the new identity-api (same pull request) defaults to 1440 and accepts up to 1440. The event dispatcher and notification worker change that accepts both the two-key and the three-key PIN notice is a separate pull request (branch claude/fervent-galileo-datz4t-pin-notice-scope, no migration) that must be merged and released before 0121: a release carrying a migration applies it before rolling out the services (scripts/production_deployment.py), and a PIN notice raised before the new services run would be refused by the old check and not retried. The websites (health's staff site and hid-system apps/web, a separate pull request) keep working and change their words and duration after 0121 is live; until then a PIN grant is write_records for the time the site asks (60 minutes).
